# Agentic Harness
    
Please read `.codex/AGENTS.md` for core repository instructions and routing rules.
The Orchestrator agent and core rules are located in `.codex/orchestrator.md`.
Run `sh .codex/scripts/setup_harness.sh` after `harness-wf init` to complete local tool, MCP, and plugin readiness checks.

## Available Agent Skills
To activate a skill, you MUST use your file reading tool to read its instructions into your context before beginning work.

- **using-superpowers**: `.codex/skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md`
- **grill-with-docs**: `.codex/skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md`
